name: Wilds of the Realmwalker
storyline:
Enter a magical world of spellcraft, survival, and exploration in Wilds of the Realmwalker, a top-down, 1–4 player cooperative survival adventure where teamwork, creativity, and accessibility come first.

As Realmwalkers—wizard explorers bonded with a magical companion—you’ll traverse ancient Spellgates, uncover lost ruins, and explore handcrafted elemental Wilds filled with secrets, danger, and wonder. Master elemental magic, build together without pressure, and survive as a group in a world designed to reward cooperation over punishment.

Whether you’re a longtime survival fan or someone who’s bounced off the genre before, Wilds of the Realmwalker offers a cozy, collaborative experience where every player can contribute meaningfully towards survival, death is forgiving, and crafted gear isn't destroyed or made irrelevant with progression. From restoring ancient sites to riding your magical companion across hostile terrain, the Wilds are meant to be explored together.
summary: A four-player cooperative survival game in which wizard explorers and their magical companions embark on enchanting adventures filled with spell crafting, exploration, and cozy, collaborative gameplay.
